O.outcome_detail: identification of additional or different areas of need

cells.quote: Interestingly, coach-identified deficits differed (including identification of additional deficits) from those identified by the PD or learner in 79%.
cells.note: Single-institution observational report; no causal coaching-versus-control comparison or inferential effect estimate was reported.

D.comparison: program director or learner referral assessment

O.outcome_detail: relative frequency of identified areas of deficit

cells.quote: Clinical reasoning was the most common reason for referral followed by medical knowledge, while interpersonal skills and communication was the most identified need by the coaches followed by clinical reasoning.
cells.note: The study reports differing rankings of needs, not a tested difference in educational or clinical outcomes.
